categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies the `dumptxoutset` RPC handler in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents a daemon crash by validating block data availability before attempting a txoutset rollback in `dumptxoutset`. As noted in the description, calling `dumptxoutset` with rollback right after `loadtxoutset` on a pruned node triggers an assertion failure in `GetFirstBlock` (`Assertion failed: ((last_block->nStatus & status_mask) == status_mask)`), terminating `bitcoind` instead of returning a proper RPC error.
